meta.title: Post-Auction Negotiation: refused for a user without the Buyer role
gaps: Sign in as a user without the Buyer role on the same tenant and verify that Post-Auction Negotiation is refused or absent, then repeat the availability check with that role comparison.
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Sign in as a user without the Buyer role on the same tenant and verify that Post-Auction Negotiation is refused or absent, then repeat the availability check with that role comparison.

steps.note: Open the prepared post-auction QCS containing vendor bids.

args.need: sign in as the user without the Buyer role and attempt Post-Auction Negotiation per vendor in the QCS, recording whether it is refused or absent

steps.note: The catalog has no step for switching to or validating a user with a different RBAC role.
As the Buyer, raise a per-vendor counter offer from the QCS.
Verify that the Buyer can complete the negotiation action.
